plan.name: Direct Cooling and Placement
plan.strategy: Immediately locate the pot, cool it using the most efficient method (e.g., fridge or water), and then place it on the diningtable.
steps: Check the diningtable first to see if the pot is already there (as per advice from E00026).
If not, search common locations for the pot, such as countertop 1 (as per E00131).
If the pot is not found on the countertop, systematically check cabinets 1 to 10 (as per E00132).
If the pot is still not found, check fridge 1 (as per E00021).
Once the pot is located, cool it using the fridge or by placing it in the sinkbasin (as per E00067).
After cooling, move the pot to the diningtable 1.
